The photo shows her wearing a light pink blazer over a white shirt, with her hair styled in loose waves. She has a warm smile and is looking directly at the camera. The background of the image is black, which makes the text stand out prominently. The text reads: "think that it is our right, and actually our obligation, to decide how women should act, behave, and look.
